title: Python PIP & Package Management
description: PIP is a package manager for Python packages, or modules if you like. A package contains all the files you need for a module. Modules are Python code libraries you can include in your project. You can download packages from the Python Package Index (PyPI) using 'pip install package_name'.
example:
// Common PIP Commands (Terminal)
# pip --version
# pip install camelcase
# pip uninstall camelcase
# pip list

# Usage of a downloaded package
import camelcase
c = camelcase.CamelCase()
txt = "hello world"
print(c.hump(txt)) # Output: Hello World
